'''Adama-Alpha Bal''' (born 18 December 2003) is a French professional [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He has previously played for the [[Westchester Knicks]] of the [[NBA G League]]. Bal played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]] and [[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara Broncos]].

==Early life==
Bal was born on 18 December 2003, and grew up in [[Le Mans]], France.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbadraft.net/players/adama-bal/|website=NBADraft.net|title=Adama Bal}}</ref> He played basketball for the third-tier [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]] (CFBB) team in [[Paris]], averaging 9.8 points, 2.4 rebounds and 2.1 assists while playing 27 minutes per game in the 2020–21 season.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/bear-down-rouge-et-bleu-arizonas-latest-commitment-gives-cats-a-french-accent/article_b36f9b78-b283-11eb-9937-fbad465dd6d2.html|newspaper=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|url-access=subscription|title=Bear Down, rouge et bleu: Arizona's latest commitment gives Cats a French accent|date=May 12, 2021|author=Pascoe, Bruce}}</ref> He was ranked one of the top European [[college basketball]] prospects and committed to play for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31427124/adama-bal-top-international-prospect-commits-arizona-wildcats|publisher=[[ESPN]]|title=Adama Bal, top international prospect, commits to Arizona Wildcats|author=Givony, Jonathan|date=May 11, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/french-speaking-teammates-help-freshman-adama-bal-adapt-to-arizona-wildcats/article_a8902bf8-2657-11ec-badb-075e553ef861.html|newspaper=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|title=French-speaking teammates help freshman Adama Bal adapt to Arizona Wildcats|date=October 6, 2021|author=Pascoe, Bruce}}</ref>

==College career==
As a [[freshman]] at Arizona in the 2021–22 season, Bal played 23 games and averaged 4.5 minutes per game, scoring 34 total points with 1.5 per game.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://arizonawildcats.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/adama-bal/14562|publisher=[[Arizona Wildcats]]|title=Adama Bal}}</ref> The following season, he played 26 games and averaged 2.5 points and shot 35.4% in 3-point range.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/changes-underway-for-wildcats-as-kerr-kriisa-adama-bal-enter-transfer-portal/article_f6ebdb16-c8e6-11ed-b841-834b0fe82b7c.html|newspaper=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|title=Changes underway for Wildcats as Kerr Kriisa, Adama Bal enter transfer portal|date=March 22, 2023|author=Pascoe, Bruce|url-access=subscription}}</ref> After having played just 104 minutes as a freshman and 214 as a [[sophomore]], Bal entered the [[NCAA transfer portal]] in 2023.<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-arizonas-adama-bal|magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: Santa Clara's Adama Bal|date=July 26, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/arizona/article/adama-bal-transfer-from-arizona-207086648/|website=[[247Sports]]|title=Adama Bal to transfer from Arizona|author=Scheer, Jason|date=May 22, 2023}}</ref>

Bal ultimately transferred to the [[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara Broncos]] for his [[Junior (education year)|junior]] year.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/former-arizona-wildcat-adama-bal-transfers-to-santa-clara/article_4b824630-dc95-11ed-8e8e-a352d68a52ed.html|newspaper=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|title=Former Arizona Wildcat Adama Bal transfers to Santa Clara|date=April 16, 2023}}</ref> He quickly became a top player for the team in the [[West Coast Conference]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2024/jan/10/key-matchup-once-a-gonzaga-recruit-adama-bal-thriv/|newspaper=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|url-access=subscription|title=Key matchup: Once a Gonzaga recruit, Adama Bal thriving at Santa Clara after two seasons at Arizona|date=January 10, 2024|author=Lawson, Theo}}</ref>
==International career==
Bal was a member of the France national under-16 basketball team and competed at the [[2019 FIBA U16 European Championship]], where he averaged 6.0 points, 1.0 rebound and 1.0 assist in seven games while helping France win second place.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/adama-bala-france-saint-marys-cincinnati-georgia-colorado-san-francisco-marquette-148221800/|website=[[247Sports]]|title=French guard Adama Bal considering college, offers roll in|date=June 16, 2020|author=Daniels, Evan}}</ref> He has also been a member of the national under-20 team, playing for them at the [[2022 FIBA U20 European Championship]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/arizonas-adama-bal-and-his-obscene-wingspan-stand-out-for-france-in-u20-european-championship/article_daf701fe-0c4b-11ed-850e-03f5aacb29f0.html|newspaper=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|title=Arizona's Adama Bal and his 'obscene wingspan' stand out for France in U20 European Championship|date=July 26, 2022|author=Pascoe, Bruce}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/still-just-18-arizonas-adama-bal-expected-to-have-bigger-role-as-a-sophomore/article_b9542fc0-4a69-11ed-bea7-ab1a52eab560.html|newspaper=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|title=Still just 18, Arizona's Adama Bal expected to have bigger role as a sophomore|date=October 12, 2022|author=Pascoe, Bruce}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On July 1, 2025, Bal signed with [[SIG Strasbourg]] of the French [[LNB Pro A]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sigstrasbourg.fr/2025/07/ben-gregg-rejoint-la-sig-strasbourg|title=Ben Gregg joins SIG Strasbourg|last=|first=|date=July 2, 2025|website=sigstrasbourg.fr|publisher=|language=fr|access-date=July 20, 2025}}</ref> However, on September 24, Bal left Strasbourg before playing for them.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/strasbourg-et-adama-bal-se-separent-deja|title=Strasbourg et Adama Bal se séparent déjà|last=Puybertier|first=Arthur|date=September 24, 2025|website=bebasket.fr|language=fr|access-date=November 4, 2025}}</ref>

On October 26, 2025, it was announced that Bal would play for the [[Westchester Knicks]] of the [[NBA G League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://westchester.gleague.nba.com/news/westchester-knicks-welcome-four-new-additions-following-2025-nba-g-league-draft|title=WESTCHESTER KNICKS WELCOME FOUR NEW ADDITIONS FOLLOWING 2025 NBA G LEAGUE DRAFT|date=October 26, 2025|website=NBA G League|access-date=November 4, 2025}}</ref>

On March 28, 2026, the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] signed Bal to a 10-day contract.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies Sign Adama Bal to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-adama-bal-to-10-day-contract|access-date=April 17, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}}</ref> On April 7, he re-signed with Memphis on a second 10-day contract.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies Sign Adama Bal to Second 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-adama-bal-to-second-10-day-contract|access-date=April 17, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}}</ref> On April 10, Bal made his first career start, recording 18 points, two rebounds, and four assists in a 101–147 loss to the [[2025–26 Utah Jazz season|Utah Jazz]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies' Adama Bal: Making first NBA start|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/grizzlies-adama-bal-making-first-nba-start/|access-date=April 17, 2026|website=cbssports.com|language=en}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Bal and fellow NBA player [[Rayan Rupert]] grew up together in France as childhood best friends; the two later became teammates on the [[2025–26 Memphis Grizzlies season|Memphis Grizzlies]] during the [[2025–26 NBA season]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=From France to Memphis, childhood best friends reunite on Grizzlies|url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/nba/grizzlies/2026/04/08/memphis-grizzlies-rayan-rupert-adama-bal-france-basketball/89458028007/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=false&gca-epti=z115543p118950l004450c118950u116943e006700v115543&gca-ft=210&gca-ds=sophi|access-date=July 7, 2026|website=commercialappeal.com|language=en}}</ref>
